beats.new_image_reason: episode opening: Iyaan at his window, brooding over where his father hid the files
beats.location: Iyaan's small bedroom in a modest Hulhumalé apartment: a plain desk with two computer monitors, a keyboard and a mouse, a black office chair, a wall-sized investigation board covered with small faceless blurred photos linked by red string, a narrow single bed with a small lamp on the bedside table, a window with half-open blinds, grey painted walls, seen in daylight with the window open onto the busy streets of the city below
beats.mood: present day, late afternoon, hazy grey-gold daylight through the blinds, muted teal shadows inside, restless and brooding
beats.visual: Iyaan standing at his bedroom window with one hand holding the blind aside, looking down at the busy street below full of motorbikes and cars, his face in three-quarter profile, serious and brooding; behind him in soft focus the desk with two dark monitors and the edge of the investigation board with red string
beats.camera: medium shot from inside the room, eye level, Iyaan in the upper half, the plain desk top as a calm lower third

shots.narration_dhivehi: އިޔާން ފުން ނޭވާއެއް ލި. އޭނާ ތެދުވެގެން ގޮސް ކުޑަދޮރުން ބޭރު ބަލާލި. ބޭރުން އިވެމުންދިޔައީ މާލޭގެ ހަލަބޮލި މަގުތަކުގައި ދުއްވާއެއްޗެހީގެ އަޑު.
shots.narration_english: Iyaan took a deep breath. He got up, went over and looked out of the window. From outside came the noise of vehicles racing along Malé's chaotic streets.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާގެ ހިތް ބުނަމުންދިޔައީ ބައްޕަގެ މަރުގެ ހަގީގީ ހެކިތައް ކޮންމެވެސް ތަނެއްގައި ވާނެ ކަމަށް. ބައްޕައަކީ ހުރިހާ ކަމެއް ވަރަށް ރޭވުންތެރިކަމާއެކު ކުރާ މީހެއް.
shots.narration_english: His heart kept telling him that the real evidence of his father's death must be somewhere. His father was a man who did everything with great planning.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ބައްޕަ މަރުވުމުގެ ކުރިން އެއްކުރި ސިޔާސީ ކޮރަޕްޝަނުގެ ފައިލްތައް ކޮބައި ހެއްޔެވެ؟ އެ ފައިލްތައް ފެނިއްޖެނަމަ، ގާތިލަކީ ކާކުކަން އެނގޭނެ.
shots.narration_english: Where were the political corruption files his father had gathered before he died? If those files were found, he would know who the killer was.

beats.new_image_reason: new focus: his father's old wristwatch stopped at the time of his death; he grips it
beats.location: Iyaan's small bedroom in a modest Hulhumalé apartment: a plain desk with two computer monitors, a keyboard and a mouse, a black office chair, a wall-sized investigation board covered with small faceless blurred photos linked by red string, a narrow single bed with a small lamp on the bedside table, a window with half-open blinds, grey painted walls, seen in daylight with the window open onto the busy streets of the city below
beats.mood: present day, late afternoon, hazy grey-gold daylight through the blinds, muted teal shadows inside, restless and brooding
beats.visual: close-up of Iyaan's hand holding an old silver analog wristwatch with a cracked glass and a plain dial without any numerals, its two hands stopped at a quarter past eleven; behind it, slightly out of focus, Iyaan's face looking down at it, jaw tight, eyes heavy with grief
beats.camera: close-up, slightly high angle, the watch and his face in the upper two-thirds, the dark desk top below
beats.safe_substitution: the time of the father's death is shown only as an old stopped watch with a plain dial, no numbers

shots.narration_dhivehi: އިޔާން އޭނާގެ މޭޒުމަތީގައި އޮތް ބައްޕަގެ ބައު ގަޑިއަށް ބަލާލި. އެ ގަޑި ވަނީ ބައްޕަ މަރުވި ވަގުތު، އެގާރަގަޑި ފަނަރައިގައި ހުއްޓިފަ.
shots.narration_english: Iyaan looked at his father's old watch lying on his desk. That watch had stopped at the moment his father died — at a quarter past eleven.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އިޔާން އެ ގަޑި އަތަށް ނަގައި ބާރަށް ފިތާލި. އޭނާގެ ދިރިއުޅުމުގެ ހިމޭންކަން ނިމުމަކަށް އަންނަން ކައިރިވެއްޖެކަމުގެ އިހުސާސް އޭނާއަށް ކުރެވެން ފެށި.
shots.narration_english: Iyaan took the watch in his hand and squeezed it hard. He began to feel that the silence of his life was coming close to its end.

beats.new_image_reason: time jump and new character: the day his mother leaves for treatment on an island
beats.location: the narrow entrance hall of a small modest apartment in Hulhumalé, a plain front door standing open onto a bright corridor, a shoe rack, a framed dried-flower picture, pale tiled floor
beats.mood: present day, morning, soft white daylight from the corridor, quiet and tender with a note of loneliness
beats.visual: Aminath at the open front door of the apartment, a small travel bag at her feet and prayer beads in her hand, turning back to look at her son with a weary loving smile; Iyaan standing a step behind her in the hallway holding a second small bag, giving a gentle reassuring nod
beats.camera: medium wide shot, eye level, faces in the upper half, the pale tiled floor as a calm lower third

shots.narration_dhivehi: އިޔާންގެ އިންތިޒާރަށް ނިމުމެއް އައީ އޭނާގެ މަންމަ އާމިނަތު، ބޭސްފަރުވާއަކަށް ރަށަށް ދާންޖެހުނު ދުވަހު.
shots.narration_english: The end of Iyaan's waiting came on the day his mother Aminath had to go to an island for medical treatment.

shots.narration_dhivehi: މަންމަ ފުރައިގެން ދިޔުމާއެކު، މުޅި އެޕާޓްމަންޓަށް ވެރިވީ ފަޅުކަން. ނަމަވެސް އިޔާންއަށް މިއީ ފާއިތުވި ފަނަރަ އަހަރުގެ ތެރޭގައި ލިބުނު އެންމެ ބޮޑު ފުރުސަތު.
shots.narration_english: With his mother's departure, emptiness took over the whole apartment. But for Iyaan this was the biggest opportunity he had had in the past fifteen years.

beats.new_image_reason: scene change: alone in the empty apartment he opens the dark storeroom; the wooden chest
beats.location: a small cramped windowless storeroom deep inside a modest apartment, dusty metal shelves with old cardboard boxes and bundles of yellowed paper, a single bare bulb hanging from the ceiling, and in the corner a large old dark-wood chest with brass corners and an old iron lock, dust motes floating in the air
beats.mood: present day, evening, the dim yellow light of a single bare bulb, deep charcoal shadows, dusty, hushed and expectant
beats.visual: Iyaan standing in the open doorway of the small dark storeroom, one hand on the door frame, the light from the hallway falling past him into the dust; his eyes fixed on a large old dark-wood chest with brass corners and an old iron lock in the far corner
beats.camera: medium wide shot from inside the storeroom, low angle, Iyaan in the upper half, the dusty floor as a calm lower third

shots.narration_dhivehi: ބައްޕަގެ ހަނދާންތަކާ ގުޅިފައިވާ، އަދި މަންމަ އަބަދުވެސް ރައްކާކޮށްގެން އުޅޭ ތަކެތި ހޯދައި ބަލަން އިޔާން ނިންމީ މަންމައަށް ނޭނގި.
shots.narration_english: Without his mother knowing, Iyaan decided to search through the things linked to his father's memories that his mother always kept safe.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެއީ މަންމަގެ ހާޒިރުގައި އެކަން ކޮށްފިނަމަ މަންމަގެ ހިތަށް ކުރާނެ އަސަރަކަށް ބަލާފަ. އިޔާން މިސްރާބު ޖެހީ ގޭގެ އެންމެ އެތެރޭގައި ހުރި ކުޑަ ގުދަން ކޮޓަރިއަށް.
shots.narration_english: That was out of concern for how it would affect her heart if he did it in front of her. Iyaan headed for the small storeroom at the very back of the home.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެއީ ދޮރު ހުޅުވާލުމާއެކު ބައު ކަރުދާހުގެ ވަސް ދުވާ، އަނދިރި ތަނެއް. ކޮޓަރީގެ ކަނެއްގައި ހުރީ ބައްޕަ އަޙްމަދު ޒާހިރުގެ ދުނިޔޭގައި ބައްޕަ ގެންގުޅުނު ބޮޑު ލަކުޑި ފޮށްޓެއް.
shots.narration_english: It was a dark place that smelled of old paper the moment the door opened. In a corner of the room stood the big wooden chest that his father, Ahmed Zahir, had kept in his lifetime.

beats.new_image_reason: action change: he blows off the dust, opens the old lock and searches the files
beats.location: a small cramped windowless storeroom deep inside a modest apartment, dusty metal shelves with old cardboard boxes and bundles of yellowed paper, a single bare bulb hanging from the ceiling, and in the corner a large old dark-wood chest with brass corners and an old iron lock, dust motes floating in the air
beats.mood: present day, evening, the dim yellow light of a single bare bulb, deep charcoal shadows, dusty, hushed and expectant
beats.visual: Iyaan kneeling in front of the open wooden chest under the bare bulb, the heavy lid raised, holding up an old faded file folder and studying it closely; old books, bundles of letters and blank yellowed papers stacked inside the chest and beside him on the floor, dust swirling in the light
beats.camera: medium shot, slightly high angle, his face in the upper half, the chest and papers in the lower third

shots.narration_dhivehi: އިޔާން ފުން ނޭވާއެއްލުމަށްފަހު ފޮށީގެ މަތީގައި ހުރި ހިރަފުސްތައް ފޮޅާލި. އަދި އޭގެ ބައު ތަޅު ހުޅުވާލި. ފޮށީގެ ތެރޭގައި ހުރީ ބައްޕަ މަޖިލީހުގައި ބޭނުންކުރި ބައު ފައިލްތަކާއި، ފޮތްތަކާއި، އަދި ބައެއް އަމިއްލަ ސިޓީތައް.
shots.narration_english: After a deep breath, Iyaan blew off the dust on top of the chest. And he opened its old lock. Inside the chest were the old files his father had used in parliament, books, and some personal letters.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އިޔާން ކޮންމެ ކަރުދާހެއް ވަކިވަކިން ބަލަމުން ދިޔަ. ނަމަވެސް އޭގެއިން އެއްވެސް އެއްޗަކުން އޭނާ ހޯދަން އުޅޭ ސިޔާސީ ސިއްރެއް ނުފެނުނު.
shots.narration_english: Iyaan went through every paper one by one. But in none of it did he find the political secret he was looking for.

beats.new_image_reason: action change: an hour later, disappointed, the chest emptied; his hand on its bottom
beats.location: a small cramped windowless storeroom deep inside a modest apartment, dusty metal shelves with old cardboard boxes and bundles of yellowed paper, a single bare bulb hanging from the ceiling, and in the corner a large old dark-wood chest with brass corners and an old iron lock, dust motes floating in the air
beats.mood: present day, evening, the dim yellow light of a single bare bulb, deep charcoal shadows, dusty, hushed and expectant
beats.visual: Iyaan sitting on the storeroom floor surrounded by piles of old files, books and envelopes, the wooden chest in front of him completely empty; his shoulders slumped in tired disappointment, one hand resting flat on the bottom inside the chest, a sudden puzzled frown appearing on his face
beats.camera: medium wide shot, eye level, his face in the upper half, the piles of paper on the floor as the lower third

shots.narration_dhivehi: ގަޑިއެއްހާ އިރުގެ މަސައްކަތަށްފަހު އިޔާން މާޔޫސްވާން ފެށި. އޭނާ ފޮށީގެ ތެރޭގައި ހުރި ހުރިހާ އެއްޗެއް ބޭރަށް ނެގި. ފޮށި އެއްކޮށް ހުސްވި.
shots.narration_english: After about an hour of work Iyaan began to lose hope. He took everything in the chest out. The chest was completely empty.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ނަމަވެސް، އިޔާން ފޮށީގެ ފުލުގައި އަތް ހާކާލި ވަގުތު، އޭނާއަށް އާދަޔާ ހިލާފު ކަމެއް ފާހަގަކުރެވުނު. ފޮށީގެ ބޭރުގެ އުސްމިނާއި އެތެރޭގެ ފުންމިނާ ދިމައެއް ނުވޭ.
shots.narration_english: But the moment Iyaan ran his hand over the bottom of the chest, he noticed something unusual. The height of the chest on the outside and its depth on the inside did not match.

beats.new_image_reason: turning point: the false bottom lifts and reveals the hidden black hard drive
beats.location: a small cramped windowless storeroom deep inside a modest apartment, dusty metal shelves with old cardboard boxes and bundles of yellowed paper, a single bare bulb hanging from the ceiling, and in the corner a large old dark-wood chest with brass corners and an old iron lock, dust motes floating in the air
beats.mood: present day, evening, the dim yellow light of a single bare bulb, deep charcoal shadows, dusty, hushed and expectant
beats.visual: close-up from above into the empty wooden chest: Iyaan's hands lifting a thin wooden panel from its bottom, revealing a hidden shallow compartment in which lies a black metal-cased hard drive; Iyaan's face above it at the top of the frame, eyes wide, breath held, lit by the bare bulb
beats.camera: close-up, high angle looking down into the chest, his face at the top of the frame

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާ ފޮށީގެ ފުލަށް ބާރަށް ފިތާލި. ކުއްލިއަކަށް ފޮށީގެ ފުލުން ބައެއް ކުޑަކޮށް ހިއްލިގެން ދިޔަ. އެއީ ސިއްރު ވަތްގަނޑެއް. އިޔާންގެ ހިތް ބާރަށް ތެޅެން ފެށި.
shots.narration_english: He pressed hard on the bottom of the chest. Suddenly a part of the bottom lifted up a little. It was a secret compartment. Iyaan's heart began to pound.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާ މަޑުމަޑުން އެ ލަކުޑިގަނޑު ނެގި. އޭގެ ތެރޭގައި އޮތީ ކަޅުކުލައިގެ، ދަގަނޑު ކޭސިންއެއްލާފައިވާ ޒަމާނީ ހާޑްޑްރައިވެއް.
shots.narration_english: Slowly he lifted out that piece of wood. Inside lay a black, metal-cased, modern hard drive.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ބައްޕަ މަރުވީ ދެހާސް އެގާރައިގައި ކަމަށްވިޔަސް، މި ހާޑްޑްރައިވަކީ އެއިރުގެ ނިސްބަތުން އެންމެ އަގުބޮޑު އަދި ސިއްރު މައުލޫމާތު ރައްކާކުރަން ގެންގުޅޭ ޒާތުގެ އެއްޗެއް.
shots.narration_english: Although his father died in 2011, this hard drive was, for its time, the most expensive kind, used to store secret information.

beats.new_image_reason: scene change: in his locked room he connects the drive — military-grade encryption
beats.location: Iyaan's small bedroom in a modest Hulhumalé apartment: a plain desk with two computer monitors, a keyboard and a mouse, a black office chair, a wall-sized investigation board covered with small faceless blurred photos linked by red string, a narrow single bed with a small lamp on the bedside table, a window with half-open blinds, grey painted walls, at night with the lights off
beats.mood: present day, late at night, the room dark except for the cold blue light of the computer screens and the faint amber glow of a small bedside lamp, tense and secretive
beats.visual: Iyaan seated at his desk in the dark locked room, both hands on the keyboard, the black metal hard drive connected by a cable beside the keyboard; both monitors show a large glowing red padlock symbol and abstract streams of glowing code with no readable characters; the colour has drained from his face, his eyes narrowed in concentration
beats.camera: medium shot from the side and slightly behind, his face in profile in the upper half, the desk top below
beats.safe_substitution: the 'enter code' message is shown only as a red padlock glow, no readable text

shots.narration_dhivehi: އިޔާން ހާޑްޑްރައިވް ހިފައިގެން ދުވެފައި ކަހަލަ ގޮތަކަށް އޭނާގެ ކޮޓަރިއަށް ވަދެ، ދޮރު ތަޅުލި. އޭނާގެ މޭޒުމަތީގައި ހުރި ކޮމްޕިއުޓަރު ސިސްޓަމަށް އެ ހާޑްޑްރައިވް ގުޅާލި.
shots.narration_english: Iyaan grabbed the hard drive, almost ran into his room and locked the door. He connected the hard drive to the computer system on his desk.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ސްކްރީނަށް އެރި މެސެޖުން އިޔާންގެ މޫނުމަތީގެ ކުލަވަރު ބަދަލުވި. މިލިޓަރީ ގްރޭޑް އެންކްރިޕްޝަން، ކޯޑު ޖައްސަވާ.
shots.narration_english: The message that came up on the screen changed the colour of Iyaan's face: "Military-grade encryption. Enter the code."

shots.narration_dhivehi: މިއީ އާދައިގެ ހެކަރަކަށްވެސް މުގުރާލެވޭނެ ކޯޑެއް ނޫން. ނަމަވެސް އިޔާންއަކީ ޑިޖިޓަލް ފޮރެންސިކްސްގެ މާހިރެއް.
shots.narration_english: This was not a code even an ordinary hacker could break. But Iyaan was a digital-forensics expert.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާ އެކި ކަހަލަ ސޮފްޓްވެއާތައް ބޭނުންކޮށްގެން އެ ކޯޑް ބްރޭކް ކުރަން މަސައްކަތް ފެށި. ފުރަތަމަ ކުރި ތިން މަސައްކަތްވެސް ނާކާމިޔާބުވި.
shots.narration_english: Using all kinds of software, he set to work breaking the code. His first three attempts all failed.

beats.camera: close-up, eye level, his face in the upper two-thirds, the dark desk edge as a calm lower third

shots.narration_dhivehi: ހާޑްޑްރައިވް ބްލޮކްވާން ކައިރިވި. އިޔާން ވިސްނާލި. ބައްޕައަކީ ހުރިހާ ކަމެއްގައިވެސް އާއިލީ ސިއްރުތަކާއި ހަނދާންތަކަށް އިސްކަންދޭ މީހެއް.
shots.narration_english: The hard drive was close to locking itself. Iyaan stopped to think. In everything, his father gave priority to family secrets and memories.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ބައްޕަ ޖަހާނީ އޭނާއަށް އެންމެ މުހިންމު ނަމެއް ނުވަތަ ތާރީޚެއް. އިޔާން ބައްޕަގެ އުފަންދުވަހާއި، މަންމަގެ ނަމާއި، ކައިވެނީގެ ތާރީޚު ޖަހާލި.
shots.narration_english: His father would only use the name or date that mattered most to him. Iyaan typed in his father's birthday, his mother's name and their wedding date.

beats.new_image_reason: memory (2011): his father whispering his favourite saying into the boy's ear
beats.location: the cosy sitting room of a family home in Malé in 2011: a worn fabric sofa, a small table lamp, rain streaming down a dark window behind
beats.mood: 2011, stormy night, cold desaturated blue-grey haze, one small warm lamp glowing on their faces, a soft dreamlike vignette, tender
beats.visual: Ahmed Zahir sitting on the sofa beside his eight-year-old son, leaning down with a warm smile to whisper into the boy's ear, one hand resting fondly on the boy's shoulder; the boy listening with wide attentive eyes; rain streaming down the dark window behind them
beats.camera: medium close-up two-shot, eye level, faces in the upper half, the sofa cushions as the lower third

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެއިން އެއްވެސް އެއްޗެއް ދިމައެއް ނުވި. ދެން އިޔާންގެ ހަނދާނަށް އައީ ބައްޕަ މަރުވުމުގެ މަދު ދުވަސްކޮޅެއް ކުރިން، އިޔާންގެ ކަންފަތްދޮށުގައި ބުނި ވާހަކައެއް.
shots.narration_english: None of them matched. Then Iyaan remembered something his father had said close to his ear a few days before he died.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ދަރިފުޅާ، ކޮންމެ ތޫފާނަކަށްފަހުވެސް ދޫނިތައް ހާލި ހަދާނީ
shots.narration_english: "My son, after every storm, the birds sing
shots.speaker: zahir

shots.narration_dhivehi: ހަމަހިމޭން މާހައުލެއްގަ. އެއީ ބައްޕަ އަބަދުވެސް ކިޔާ އުޅޭ ހިކުމަތްތެރި ބަހެއް. އިޔާން އެ ބަސްތައް އިނގިރޭސިބަހަށް ތަރުޖަމާކޮށް، ބައްޕަ އާންމުކޮށް ކޯޑު ހަދާ ގޮތަށް އަކުރުތަކާއި ނަންބަރުތައް ތަރުތީބުކޮށްލި.
shots.narration_english: in calm weather." It was a wise saying his father always used to repeat. Iyaan translated those words into English and arranged the letters and numbers the way his father usually made his codes.
shots.speaker: zahir

beats.new_image_reason: return from the memory to the desk: he turns the saying into a code and types it in

shots.narration_dhivehi: އަދި އެންމެ ފަހު ފުރުސަތުގައި އެ ކޯޑު އެންޓާ ކޮށްލި. ކޮމްޕިއުޓަރުގެ ސްކްރީން ދެފަހަރަކު ބްލިންކްވެލި. އަދި ފެހިކުލައިގެ މެސެޖެއް އެރި.
shots.narration_english: And with his very last chance he entered the code. The computer screen blinked twice. And a green message appeared.

beats.new_image_reason: turning point: access granted — a green glow, the files open, his eyes widen
beats.location: Iyaan's small bedroom in a modest Hulhumalé apartment: a plain desk with two computer monitors, a keyboard and a mouse, a black office chair, a wall-sized investigation board covered with small faceless blurred photos linked by red string, a narrow single bed with a small lamp on the bedside table, a window with half-open blinds, grey painted walls, at night with the lights off

beats.camera: medium close-up from beside the monitors, his face in the upper half lit green, the keyboard in the lower third
beats.safe_substitution: 'ACCESS GRANTED' is shown only as a green glow, no readable text

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެކްސެސް ގްރާންޓެޑް. އިޔާންގެ ހަށިގަނޑުގެ އެތެރޭގައި ފިނި ރާޅެއް ދުވެލިކަހަލަ. ހާޑްޑްރައިވްގެ އެތެރޭގައި ހުރި ފައިލްތައް ހުޅުވިގެން ދިޔަ.
shots.narration_english: "Access granted." It was as if a cold wave ran through Iyaan's body. The files inside the hard drive opened up.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެއީ ގައުމުގެ ސިޔާސީ މަސްރަހު އެކޮޅުމިކޮޅަށް ޖަހާލެވޭނެ ފަދަ، ބޮޑެތި ސިއްރު ލިޔެކިޔުންތަކެއް.
shots.narration_english: They were huge secret documents that could turn the country's political stage upside down.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ބޭންކް އެކައުންޓްތަކުގެ ތަފްސީލްތަކާއި، ކަޅު ފައިސާ ބެހި ގޮތުގެ ލިސްޓުތައް. އިޔާންގެ ދެލޯ ބޮޑުވި.
shots.narration_english: Details of bank accounts, and lists of how black money had been shared out. Iyaan's eyes widened.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ބައްޕަ ވަނީ ގައުމުގެ އެންމެ މަތީ ފަންތީގެ ވިއުގައެއްގެ ފަރުދާ ކަހާލާފަ. އިޔާން އެ ފައިލްތައް ކިޔަން ފެށީ، އޭނާގެ ބައްޕަގެ މަރުގެ ހަގީގަތާ ދިމާއަށް ދެވޭނެ ކަމުގެ ފުރިހަމަ ޔަގީންކަމާއެކުގަ.
shots.narration_english: His father had torn the curtain off a network at the very top of the country. Iyaan began reading those files with complete certainty that they would lead him to the truth of his father's death.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ހާޑްޑްރައިވްގެ އެތެރޭގައި ހުރި ފޯލްޑަރުތަކުގެ ތެރެއަށް އިޔާންގެ ދެލޯ ހުއްޓިފައި ހުރި. ކޮޓަރީގެ އެނދުމަތީގައި ހުރި ކުޑަ ބޮކީގެ ރީނދޫ އަލި ފިޔަވައި، މުޅި ތަނަށް ވެރިވެފައި އޮތީ ކޮމްޕިއުޓަރު ސްކްރީނުގެ ނޫކުލައިގެ އަލިކަން.
shots.narration_english: Iyaan's eyes stayed fixed on the folders inside the hard drive. Apart from the soft light of a small lamp by the bed, the whole room was ruled by the blue light of the computer screen.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އިޔާންގެ އިނގިލިތައް މައުސް މަތީގައި ތުރުތުރުއަޅަމުން ދިޔައީ ނޭނގޭ ބިރުވެރިކަމެއްގެ ސަބަބުން. އޭނާ ކޮންމެ ފައިލެއް ވަކިވަކިން ހުޅުވަމުން ދިޔަ.
shots.narration_english: Iyaan's fingers trembled on the mouse from a fear he could not name. He opened every file one by one.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭގައި ހުރީ ދެހާސް އެގާރަ ވަނަ އަހަރު ރާއްޖޭގެ ސިޔާސީ މަސްރަހުގައި ހިނގަމުންދިޔަ އެންމެ ބޮޑު ހިޔާނާތްތަކުގެ ތަފްސީލީ ރިޕޯޓުތައް.
shots.narration_english: In them were detailed reports of the biggest betrayals going on on the Maldives' political stage in 2011.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ދައުލަތުގެ ބިންތަކާއި ފަޅުތައް ސިއްރުން ވިއްކާލައިގެން ލިބުނު މިލިއަން ޑޮލަރު ވަދެފައިވާ ބޭންކު އެކައުންޓުތަކުގެ ތަފްސީލު.
shots.narration_english: Details of bank accounts into which millions of dollars had flowed from secretly selling off state land and lagoons.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އިޔާން ކިޔަމުން ދިޔަ ވަރަކަށް، އޭނާގެ ބައްޕަގެ ހިތްވަރުގަދަކަމާމެދު ހިތާހިތުން ސާބަސްދެވުނު. އަހްމަދު ޒާހިރު އެ ހޯދާފައިވަނީ އާދައިގެ ސިއްރުތަކެއް ނޫން.
shots.narration_english: The more Iyaan read, the more he silently praised his father's courage. What Ahmed Zahir had found were no ordinary secrets.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާ ވަނީ މުޅި ދައުލަތް ސިއްރުން ކޮންޓްރޯލްކުރަމުންދިޔަ ވިއުގައެއްގެ ހަގީގަތް ހާމަކޮށްފަ. އެ ފައިލްތަކުގެ އެންމެ ފުލުގައި އޮތް ކޮންފިޑެންޝަލް އޯޑިއޯ ދެހާސް އެގާރަ ނަމަކަށް ކިޔާ ފޯލްޑަރެއް އިޔާންއަށް ފެނުނު.
shots.narration_english: He had exposed the truth of a network secretly controlling the whole state. At the very bottom of the files Iyaan saw a folder named "Confidential Audio 2011".

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެ ފޯލްޑަރު ހުޅުވާލުމާއެކު އޭގެ ތެރެއިން ފެނުނީ އެންމެ އޯޑިއޯ ފައިލެއް. އިޔާން އޭނާގެ ހެޑްފޯން ކަންފަތުގައި އެޅި. އޭނާ އެ އޯޑިއޯ ފައިލް ޕްލޭ ކޮށްލި.
shots.narration_english: When he opened the folder there was just one audio file inside. Iyaan put his headphones on his ears. He played the audio file.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ފުރަތަމަ އިވުނީ ފޯނެއް ރިންގުވާ އަޑު. ދެން އިވުނީ ބަރު، ކޮންމެވެސް ވަރަކަށް ކުރެހިފައިވާ ފިރިހެން އަޑެއް.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެ އަޑު އިވުމާއެކު އިޔާންގެ މުޅި ހަށިގަނޑުގެ ލޭ ކެކިގަތް ކަހަލަ އިހުސާސެއް ކުރެވުނު. އެއީ އޭނާއަށް ޓީވީތަކުންނާއި ހަބަރުތަކުން ކޮންމެ ދުވަހަކުހެން އިވޭ އަޑެއް.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާ ބުނީ ގައުމުގެ ޒުވާނުންގެ ހައްގުގައި މި ފަސްގަނޑުން ކޮރަޕްޝަން ފޮހެލާނަމޭ. އާސިމް ބާރަށް ހީނގަތް އަޑު އޯޑިއޯއިން އިވުނު.

shots.narration_english: Shut his mouth for good. Make tonight his last night in this world. And

shots.narration_dhivehi: އިޔާންގެ އަޑުން ނިކުތީ ވޭނީ ރިހުމެއް. އިޔާންގެ ލޮލުން ކަރުނައެއް ނައީ. ނަމަވެސް އޭނާގެ ދެލޮލުން ފެންނަމުންދިޔައީ ނުރައްކާތެރި އަލިފާނެއް.
shots.narration_english: A painful growl came out of Iyaan's voice. Not a tear came from Iyaan's eyes. But in his eyes burned a dangerous fire.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާގެ ހިތުގައި އޮތް ބަދަލުހިފުމުގެ ރޫހު މިހާރު ވަނީ އާދަޔާ ހިލާފަށް ވަރުގަދަވެފަ. އިޔާންއަކީ ކެތްތެރި، ރޭވުންތެރި ޒުވާނެއް.
shots.narration_english: The spirit of revenge in his heart had now grown unusually strong. Iyaan was a patient, calculating young man.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ސީދާ ދާގޮތަށްގޮސް އާސިމް މަރާލުމަކީ ކުރެވޭނެކަމެއް ނޫންކަން އޭނާއަށް އެނގޭ.
shots.narration_english: He knew that simply going straight at Asim and taking his life was not something that could be done.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އިޔާން ބޭނުންވީ އާސިމް ބިނާކޮށްފައިވާ މުޅި ސިޔާސީ ހައިބަތާއި އޭނާގެ އަބުރާއި، ނުފޫޒާއި، އާއިލާ އޭނާގެ ކުރިމަތީގައި ފުނޑުފުނޑުވެގެންދާ މަންޒަރު ދެކޭން.
shots.narration_english: What Iyaan wanted was to see the whole political might Asim had built, his honour, his influence and his family shatter to pieces before his eyes.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އާސިމްގެ ފައިދަށުން ބިންގަނޑު ދެމިގެންދާ ވަގުތު، އޭނާ ބިރުން ސަލާމަތަށް އެދި އާދޭސްކުރާ މަންޒަރު ދެކެން.
shots.narration_english: To see him, when the ground slid from under Asim's feet, begging in fear for mercy.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އިޔާން އަނެއްކާވެސް ކޮމްޕިއުޓަރު ކައިރިއަށް ގޮސް އިށީނދެ، އާސިމްގެ އަމިއްލަ ދިރިއުޅުމުގެ މައުލޫމާތުތައް ހޯދަން ފެށި.
shots.narration_english: Iyaan went back to the computer again, sat down, and began gathering information on Asim's private life.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އާސިމްގެ ހުރިހާ ނުފޫޒެއްގެ ބަލިފަޔަކީ ކޮބައިތޯ ހޯދަންފެށި. އެތައް ގަޑިއިރެއްގެ ދިރާސާއަށްފަހު، އިޔާންއަށް އެ ދިމާއެއް ފެނުނު.
shots.narration_english: He began looking for the weak point of all Asim's influence. After many hours of research, Iyaan found that point.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އެއީ އާސިމްގެ ހަމައެކަނި ދަރިފުޅު، ރާޔާ. ރާޔާއަކީ ސިޔާސީ ކަންކަމާ ދުރު، މާލޭގައި ބޮޑު އާޓް ގެލެރީއެއް ހިންގަމުންދާ، މިނިވަން ހިޔާލުގެ ޒުވާން އަންހެން ކުއްޖެއް.
shots.narration_english: It was Asim's only child, Raaya. Raaya was a free-thinking young woman, far from politics, who runs a big art gallery in Malé.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އާސިމް އޭނާގެ ދަރިފުޅު ދެކެ އިންތިހާއަށް ލޯބިވޭ. އިޔާން ސްކްރީނަށް ބަލަހައްޓައިގެން އިނދެ ނުރައްކާތެރި ގޮތަކަށް ހިނިތުންވެލި.
shots.narration_english: Asim loves his daughter beyond measure. Iyaan sat staring at the screen and smiled dangerously.
